ConnectionStrings._comment: G8 (garbati-platform T-038) fix: port was 5436, colliding with Garbati.StaffIdentityApi's own local dev Postgres port - anyone running both services directly on the host at once would have hit this. Bumped to the next free port in the sequence (LedgerApi 5433, IdentityApi 5434, OrchestratorApi 5435, StaffIdentityApi 5436, OpsApi 5437).

DownstreamServices._comment: Resolved by garbati-platform T-038's docker-compose stack: each sibling service now defines a 'compose-opsapi' client matching these exact ApiKey strings, so these DO authenticate when run via docker-compose (the stack also overrides BaseUrl to each service's container name, since 'localhost' only makes sense when every service runs directly on the host). Running each service individually via 'dotnet run' instead of compose still needs real keys issued by each sibling - see each one's own README.
